    Frequently Asked Questions.

    Everything you need to know about HR ROI in the UAE

    How is HR ROI calculated in UAE?

    HR ROI in UAE is calculated as: [(Total Annual Savings − Annual Software Cost) ÷ Annual Software Cost] × 100. Total savings include HR admin time reduction (35% of HR team cost), recruitment cost reduction (20% per hire), WPS payroll error avoidance (0.5% of payroll), gratuity miscalculation cost avoided, and employee self-service productivity gains (2 hours per employee per month). UAE-specific inputs — WPS SIF automation and gratuity accuracy — typically add 30–40% to the ROI versus global calculators.

    What is a good ROI for HR software in UAE?

    A strong first-year HR ROI for a UAE company with 50–200 employees is 200–400%. ConnectHR customers typically recover their annual subscription within 4–8 months, with the biggest ROI drivers being WPS payroll automation (eliminates SIF error risk) and HR admin time reduction (35% of HR team cost). Companies in high-turnover sectors — hospitality, F&B, construction — typically see the highest ROI due to recruitment savings.

    How much does a payroll error cost in UAE?

    A WPS SIF file rejection costs AED 500–5,000 per incident according to the MOHRE fine schedule — plus the HR time cost of reprocessing, typically 3–8 hours. Gratuity miscalculations cost an average of AED 5,000–15,000 per dispute when escalated to MOHRE, not including legal fees. For a 50-person company processing manual payroll, these errors typically total AED 25,000–40,000 per year — most of which Connect HR eliminates on day one.

    What is the payback period for HR in UAE?

    Most UAE companies using Connect HR reach payback within 4–8 months. Payback period = Annual Software Cost ÷ Annual Total Savings × 12. The fastest payback occurs when: (1) the HR team is 3+ FTE and (2) employee turnover is above 15%. A single avoided MOHRE dispute or WPS penalty can cover several months of subscription cost.

    Does the calculator include WPS and gratuity savings?

    Yes — and it’s the only UAE HR ROI calculator that does. The Connect HR calculator includes WPS SIF automation savings (payroll error rate × annual payroll) and gratuity miscalculation risk (errors per year × average UAE dispute cost of AED 8,000). Zimyo and Darwinbox’s calculators do not break out these UAE-specific compliance cost lines. For most UAE employers, WPS and gratuity together represent 35–50% of total HR savings.

    How do I show HR ROI to my CFO?

    Use the Connect HR ROI Calculator to generate a personalised AED figure — CFOs respond to specific numbers, not percentages. Enter your headcount, salary, HR team size, turnover rate, and cost per hire. The calculator outputs annual savings, 3-year ROI, and payback period in a format ready for a board presentation. Request a tailored ROI report from Connect HR’s team to add your company’s specific compliance exposure (visa fines, Emiratisation penalties) to the business case.

    You have different questions? 

    Our team will answer all your questions. We ensure a quick response.

    Contact Support Team

    Ready to put this savings to work?

    Book a 20-minute demo. A ConnectHR specialist will walk through your payroll, WPS compliance, and gratuity setup — and build a tailored business case for your CFO.

title: HR Software Hotels UAE
content:
The Complete Guide to HR Software for Hotels in UAE: What Every Hotel Owner Needs to Know

With its tourism sector contributing over AED 180 billion to GDP, UAE is all set to attract 40 million hotel guests annually by 2031. If you are a hotel owner or a worker in the hospitality sector, you are already dealing with a high volume of guests and paperwork. Having to manage yet another spreadsheet for workforce management might be affecting your workflow and instead reducing the efficiency.

Running a hotel might look smooth to an outsider, with guests simply checking in, rooms getting cleaned on schedule, and service being flawless. But behind the scenes though, your people are the ones holding everything together. Rotating shifts, visa renewals, accommodation assignments, payroll deadlines, and constant hiring demand all require attention. When these important tasks remain within spreadsheets and scattered files, mistakes quietly pile up.

Hotel operations move too fast for manual systems. That’s why many hotel operators are now integrating HR software for hotels in UAE as an integral part of their workflow. A good HR platform keeps staff records organized, payroll compliant, and workforce decisions clear.

If you run a hotel or manage one, our guide discusses what HR software actually solves, what features matter in hospitality, and how you can evaluate if that system works for you.

Book a Free Demo

Why Hotel HR is More Complex Than Most Businesses

Hospitality teams have different schedules than white collar jobs. There is seasonal staff and many employees live in company accommodation. All of these factors mean HR requires a system that’s quicker than most spreadsheets designed for 9-to-5 offices could handle.

A single hotel has to manage all these and beyond:

  • Front desk agents on rotating shifts
  • Housekeeping teams across multiple floors
  • Food and beverage staff working split shifts
  • Maintenance teams covering 24 hour operations
  • Visa dependent employees from multiple countries

Each department in the hospitality sector operates on different schedules, documents, and reporting needs. When those records are scattered in multiple emails, files, and Excel sheets, HR teams are forced to spend more time searching than managing.

The Hidden Cost of Managing Hotel HR Manually

Most hotels do not start with HR software. They begin with spreadsheets, printed forms, and manual records. At first, this works fine. But as the team grows, the cracks start showing: Payroll errors begin appearing because attendance records are scattered. Visa renewals approach without reminders. Accommodation records become outdated.

These small inefficiencies turn into operational risks. Payroll delays frustrate employees. Missing visa deadlines create legal exposure. Hiring slows down because paperwork takes too long. Managers lose visibility into staff allocation. It affects service quality, staff morale, and operational stability.

What Good Hotel HR Software Actually Does

The purpose of HR software is simple. It replaces fragmented records with a structured system that handles daily workforce operations.

For hotels, the right platform focuses on 6 practical areas:

  1. Employee data management
  2. Recruitment and hiring workflows
  3. Onboarding and document tracking
  4. Visa compliance and renewals
  5. Payroll processing and WPS reporting
  6. Employee accommodation management

Instead of maintaining separate tools for each task, a single system organizes them under 1 platform, which allows hotel management to see the full picture of their workforce without having to rely on manual reports.

Ready to digitize your HR software for hotels

Our experts will show you the software in action so that you can see how it works. We look forward to your message

See how it works
Book a demo

Key Features to Look for in HR software for hotels in UAE

Hospitality businesses have specific HR requirements that generic systems often miss. A platform designed for the actual region and the industry makes daily operations much smoother. These are the functions hotel owners should evaluate carefully:

Payroll that Supports WPS Compliance

Payroll errors are one of the quickest ways to damage employee trust. In the UAE, it comes with legal consequences.

Hotels are required to process salaries through the Wage Protection System (WPS), which means payroll files must follow specific formatting and reporting rules. A dedicated WPS payroll module automatically prepares salary files in the required format.

Visa Tracking

Many hospitality employees work under company sponsored visas. That means every employee record carries an expiration date. Tracking these manually across dozens or hundreds of staff members becomes risky.

A proper visa management system stores employee documents, alerts HR teams about upcoming renewals, and keeps all visa related information in one place. Using dedicated tools for visa management and visa tracker helps hotels maintain compliance without having to constantly monitor for renewal dates.

Faster Hiring for High Turnover Roles

Recruitment management tools make the difference between weeks of hiring delays and efficient staffing for hotels expanding their workforce. Staff turnover, seasonal demands, and new hotel openings — all these constant recruitment needs require faster decisions for your hiring workflows.

A reliable recruitment management software organizes job postings, candidate profiles, interview stages, and hiring approvals in one place. Managers can review candidates quickly and move the process forward without paperwork delays.

Smooth Employee Onboarding

When a new employee joins, there are multiple tasks you need to handle simultaneously. This includes issuing their employment contract, storing HR documents, creating payroll records, and updating accommodation assignments.

An onboarding system standardizes the process. Each new hire moves through predefined steps so HR teams know exactly what needs completion, reducing missed paperwork and helping new employees settle into their roles faster.

Oftentimes, hotels prefer combining their onboarding and offboarding tools so employee records remain organized even when staff leave the organization.

Managing Staff Accommodation Efficiently

Many hotels provide accommodation for their employees, especially housekeeping, service staff, and maintenance teams. Managing these living arrangements manually means HR teams need to track who lives where, when rooms change, and when employees move out.

An HRMS with an employee accommodation module helps with this, so rooms, buildings, and occupancy records stay updated in one place. Managers can view housing capacity without relying on manual lists. For hotels managing large staff residences, this feature alone saves hours of administrative work each month.

How HR Software Changes Daily Hotel Operations

Payroll processing time drops because attendance data flows directly into salary calculations. Visa renewals appear as reminders. Recruitment pipelines stay organized so managers can approve hires faster.

Instead of waiting for HR reports, hotel leadership gains immediate visibility into staffing levels, department allocations, and payroll summaries. This empowers better decisions around hiring, budgeting, and operational planning.

Choosing the Right HR System

As hotel owners, you are looking for a system that’s designed for hospitality operations, not generic corporate HR. We have a few tips that’d help you choose the system that’s right for your industry:

  1. Make sure that the system supports UAE’s legal requirements such as WPS payroll and visa tracking.
  2. Choose a platform that groups multiple HR processes together instead of forcing you to buy separate tools.
  3. Focus on usability. Your HR team should be able to easily operate the system without technical training.
  4. Consider scalability, as hotels grow quickly. Your HR system should have the capability to grow alongside your workforce.

Why UAE Hotels Are Moving Toward Integrated HR Platforms

If you run a hotel or manage one, our guide discusses what HR software actually solves, what features matter in hospitality, and how you can evaluate if that system works for you.

Book a Free Demo

A single hotel has to manage all these and beyond:

  • Food and beverage staff working split shifts
  • Maintenance teams covering 24 hour operations
  • Visa dependent employees from multiple countries

Accommodation records become outdated.

These small inefficiencies turn into operational risks. Payroll delays frustrate employees. Missing visa deadlines create legal exposure. Hiring slows down because paperwork takes too long. Managers lose visibility into staff allocation. It affects service quality, staff morale, and operational stability.

The purpose of HR software is simple. It replaces fragmented records with a structured system that handles daily workforce operations.

Why UAE Hospitals Need Purpose-Built HR Software for Healthcare

A Complete Guide

Hospitals and healthcare don’t slow down for anyone. Patients arrive at all hours with all different kinds of emergencies and conditions requiring immediate attention. Departments undergo massive shifts without prior warning. And behind every doctor or nurse stands an HR team trying to keep staffing, documentation, and compliance aligned. Hospitals today are not struggling with a lack of people. They struggle with managing the right people, at the right time, with the right credentials.

When workforce management is affected, the impact echoes throughout. Patient care slows. Staff experience burnout. Compliance risks increase. That’s why more healthcare leaders now rely on HR software for healthcare in UAE to manage their workforce.

Ask for a demo
Our pricing

Operational Challenges that UAE Hospitals Face Today

Hospitals operate around the clock while managing strict licensing requirements and patient safety responsibilities. For hospital administrators and HR leaders, the daily list of workforce responsibilities continues to grow: Staff licenses should always be up-to-date with renewals, departments must remain fully staffed across multiple shifts, payroll needs to account for overtime, allowances, and emergency coverage.

Discuss with our expert

Why Traditional HR Systems Fail in Healthcare

Most HR tools were designed for white collar jobs with office environments in mind. Hospitals operate differently, and that’s exactly where generic HR systems fail.

General HR systems struggle with managing complex healthcare workforce operations. This is evident in how licenses expire without any automated alerts going out. Missing a license renewal can prevent a medical professional from legally practising. That oversight can disrupt your entire department. Shift planning becomes difficult when departments are already operating 24 hours a day. Payroll calculations become even more complicated when overtime, night allowances, and on call coverage enter the equation.

Most often, HR teams generally rely on spreadsheets and manual reminders to help them maintain control. This seems manageable, but is actually consuming more time and increasing risk in a sector where risk can be too expensive.

The Hidden Cost of Manual HR Processes

Many hospitals continue relying on spreadsheets and paper records because those systems feel familiar. Yet the hidden cost appears in wasted hours and operational inefficiencies. HR teams spend significant time answering these routine questions from staff:

  • Where is my payslip?
  • How many leave days remain?
  • When does my license expire?

These interruptions accumulate throughout the week.

A digital HR platform introduces employee self service portals that allow staff to access their own information instantly. Payslips, leave balances, and schedule updates become available through secure portals. HR teams regain hours every week that would otherwise disappear into routine requests. Those hours return to work that strengthens workforce management.

What Purpose-Built HR Systems Actually Solve for Hospitals

Healthcare organizations in the UAE operate under strict regulatory expectations. Labour laws, Emiratisation initiatives, and healthcare authority licensing requirements impact how hospitals manage their workforce. This is why hospitals increasingly adopt HR software for healthcare in UAE that reflects these operational realities.

Unlike generic HR platforms, healthcare focused systems support compliance management, credential tracking, and workforce scheduling built specifically for hospitals. These platforms adapt to healthcare workflows rather than forcing HR teams to adjust their processes.

The difference becomes visible quickly in how administrative work decreases, compliance visibility improves, and HR teams gain confidence that workforce operations remain under control.

What makes us different

How Specialized HR Software Solves Healthcare Workforce Challenges

Purpose built HR platforms focus on the operational areas that create the most pressure inside hospitals. Instead of scattered systems and manual processes, HR teams gain one structured solution to manage their workforce operations.

Credential and License Tracking

Healthcare professionals operate under strict licensing requirements. Doctors, nurses, technicians, and pharmacists must maintain valid certifications.

Manual tracking often leads to missed renewal dates or incomplete documentation. Specialized HR systems store credentials in centralized employee profiles and send renewal alerts well before expiration. Hospitals maintain audit ready records without manual monitoring. This helps HR teams shift away from reacting to problems to instead actively preventing them.

Shift Scheduling Across Departments

Fixed working hours is not how hospitals operate. There are multiple rotating shifts.

Having advanced scheduling tools allow HR teams and department heads to easily assign shifts across departments while avoiding any overtime conflicts and coverage gaps at the same time.

Administrators maintain control over workforce distribution and staff members can view their upcoming schedules. Better scheduling reduces burnout and thus stabilizes patient care.

Payroll Built for Healthcare Complexity

Payroll process in healthcare involves far more variables than most industries. Night shifts, weekend allowances, overtime, emergency coverage, and on call duties require correct calculations. Manual payroll calculations increase the risk of mistakes that frustrate staff and damage trust.

Automated payroll systems apply defined rules for allowances, overtime, and leave deductions. HR teams supervise the process rather than calculating every detail manually

Turning Workforce Data Into Leadership Insight

Hospital administrators often make workforce decisions based on partial information. When HR data is stored across spreadsheets, emails, and disconnected systems, leadership lacks a clear operational picture.

Purpose built HR systems consolidate workforce data into centralized dashboards.

Administrators gain access to insights such as departmental staffing levels, overtime trends, employee turnover patterns, and training completion rates.

These insights allow leadership teams to ask better operational questions:

  • Which departments experience consistent understaffing?
  • Are overtime costs rising due to scheduling gaps?
  • Which teams require additional training support?

Planning becomes easier and decisions become faster when leadership can see the full picture.

Training and Professional Development Become Easier to Track

Healthcare professionals train continuously throughout their careers. New treatment protocols emerge. Equipments get more advanced. Regulations change. Staff must stay updated.

Manual training records often scatter across email attachments, spreadsheets, and physical files. During audits, HR teams scramble to locate documentation.

A structured HR platform records training progress directly within employee profiles. HR teams and department heads instantly see completed certifications, upcoming training requirements, and staff eligible for specialized roles.

Training stops being a collection of documents and becomes a structured development pathway. Hospitals benefit because their workforce remains qualified and prepared.

Improving Communication Across Hospital Teams

Hospitals depend on constant coordination:

  1. Doctors communicate with nurses
  2. Nurses collaborate with technicians
  3. Department heads coordinate with administration
  4. HR teams interact with everyone

When important information spreads across emails and disconnected systems, communication becomes slower. Staff members repeatedly request information simply because they cannot locate it.

Centralized HR platforms act as a shared information hub. HR teams can publish policy updates, training announcements, and shift notifications in one location. Employees access information without having to send repeated requests. As a result, communication becomes faster and clearer.

Scaling Operations

Healthcare providers across the UAE continue expanding rapidly. Dubai Health Authority (DHA) has recently released data which shows that the number of licensed health care facilities went up to nearly 5,800 in 2025. It has gone up from 5,340 in 2024, which is an increase of more than 8 per cent.

Gulf news reported that the network now includes 55 hospitals, 68 specialised clinics, 60 day-surgery centres, 70 general dental clinics, 126 general medical clinics, 222 home health care centres and 101 alternative medicine centres.

UAE has also recorded a sharp rise in health care professionals, with the private sector workforce exceeding 69,400 in 2025, compared to 64,100 of the previous year, another growth rate of over 8 per cent.

As private clinics grow into multi-location networks and hospitals open new departments to meet rising patient demand, it gives way to new workforce management challenges.

Managing staff across multiple locations requires visibility into:

  • Which departments need additional hires?
  • Which clinics operate below capacity?
  • Where do scheduling conflicts appear most often?

Without centralized systems, leadership relies on fragmented reports. On the other hand, a well-designed HR platform gives administrators a clear view across the organization. Leadership can see workforce data across departments and locations without collecting manual reports.

This helps hospitals:

  • Monitor their staffing levels across facilities
  • Coordinate workforce distribution
  • Identify hiring needs early
  • Maintain consistent policies across locations

Ready to try Connect HR Software for Healthcare ?

Our experts will show you the software in action so that you can see how it works. We look forward to your message

Book a free demo

How UAE Hospitals Should Evaluate HR Software

Hospital administrators evaluating HR systems should look beyond general feature lists. The priority should be whether the platform understands healthcare workforce complexity.

These 3 questions can help you determine whether a system is actually built for healthcare:

Does the system support clinical licensing oversight?

Healthcare institutions are responsible for tracking credentials across multiple authorities including DHA, DOH, and MOH. A suitable platform will automate license monitoring, renewal alerts, and documentation storage.

Can the platform manage 24 hour workforce scheduling?

Hospitals require flexible scheduling tools capable of handling rotating shifts, emergency coverage, and cross-department staffing adjustments. So the HRMS should be designed to support this level of complex operations.

Does it support UAE labour compliance and payroll rules?

Hospitals in the UAE are required to deal with visa management, WPS payroll reporting, and labour law requirements. The HR systems built with local regulations compliance will significantly reduce administrative risk.

Case Study

How UAE Healthcare Providers Are Modernising HR Operations

Many hospitals and clinics across the UAE have already begun replacing manual HR processes with integrated workforce management systems. One healthcare provider recently implemented a centralized HR platform to manage licensing oversight, shift scheduling, payroll compliance, and employee self-service.

The result was immediately noticeable, with license expiry alerts reducing compliance risks, automated payroll systems calculating allowances accurately and generating WPS compliant files. Self-service portals allow their multinational staff to access payslips and leave requests without having to contact HR every time.

Make Workforce Management in Hospitals Look Easy

Workforce management should never become the barrier between medical teams and patient care.

Healthcare professionals dedicate enormous effort to patient care every day. The real challenge often comes with HR teams carrying the responsibility of keeping workforce operations organized while hospitals continue growing and adapting.

When those teams rely on manual systems, the workload expands quickly. Digital HR platforms change that equation. They bring structure to workforce data. They support compliance and staffing coordination. They reduce repetitive tasks and improve communication across departments.

 

Frequently asked questions.

What is HR software for hospitals in UAE?

HR software for hospitals in UAE is a specialized system designed to manage healthcare workforce operations such as staff scheduling, payroll, license tracking, and compliance. Unlike generic HR tools, it is built to handle 24/7 hospital environments, regulatory requirements, and complex staffing needs across departments.

Why do hospitals need purpose-built HR software instead of generic systems?

Hospitals require purpose-built HR software because generic systems fail to handle healthcare-specific challenges like license tracking, rotating shifts, and complex payroll structures. Without specialized tools, hospitals rely on spreadsheets and manual processes, which increase compliance risks and operational inefficiencies.

How does HR software help hospitals maintain compliance in UAE?

HR software helps hospitals maintain compliance by tracking employee licenses, storing documentation, and sending automated renewal alerts. It also supports UAE labor laws, including WPS payroll requirements, ensuring hospitals remain audit-ready and avoid legal risks related to expired credentials or incorrect payroll processing.

Can HR software manage hospital shift scheduling effectively?

Yes, HR software is designed to manage complex hospital scheduling, including rotating shifts, emergency coverage, and cross-department staffing. It allows administrators to assign shifts efficiently, avoid staffing gaps, and give employees visibility into their schedules, reducing burnout and improving operational stability.

What are the key features hospitals should look for in HR software?

Hospitals should look for features such as credential and license tracking, advanced shift scheduling, healthcare-specific payroll automation, employee self-service portals, and centralized workforce dashboards. These features help reduce administrative workload, improve decision-making, and ensure smooth hospital operations.

You have different questions? 

Our team will answer all your questions. We ensure a quick response.

UAE has also recorded a sharp rise in health care professionals, with the private sector workforce exceeding 69,400 in 2025, compared to 64,100 of the previous year, another growth rate of over 8 per cent.

As private clinics grow into multi-location networks and hospitals open new departments to meet rising patient demand, it gives way to new workforce management challenges.

  • Where do scheduling conflicts appear most often?

Healthcare institutions are responsible for tracking credentials across multiple authorities including DHA, DOH, and MOH. A suitable platform will automate license monitoring, renewal alerts, and documentation storage.

Can the platform manage 24 hour workforce scheduling?

Hospitals require flexible scheduling tools capable of handling rotating shifts, emergency coverage, and cross-department staffing adjustments. So the HRMS should be designed to support this level of complex operations.

Does it support UAE labour compliance and payroll rules?

Hospitals in the UAE are required to deal with visa management, WPS payroll reporting, and labour law requirements. The HR systems built with local regulations compliance will significantly reduce administrative risk.

content:
Privacy Policy

At HRMS IT SOLUTIONS LLC (trading as ConnectHR and part of the Connect Group of companies, including affiliates and subsidiaries, collectively “ConnectHR,” “we,” or the “Company”), we value the trust you place in us when sharing your information. Protecting your privacy is a responsibility we take seriously, and we want you to understand how we handle your personal data.

ConnectHR provides a cloud-based human resources and payroll management platform, available through our web application, mobile apps, and our official website connecthr.ae. Together, these services form the basis of our digital HR solutions.

Who Our Users Are

Our users may include:

  • Customers: organizations (such as employers) that have signed an agreement with ConnectHR, or resellers/partners authorized to deliver our services.
  • End users: individuals who use the ConnectHR platform at the direction of a customer, such as employees or staff

For clarity, throughout this Privacy Policy, “users” or “you” refers collectively to both customers and end users.

Scope of This Policy

This Privacy Policy explains our practices regarding the collection, use, correction, and disclosure of personal data through:

  • Our website (connecthr.ae)
  • Our mobile applications
  • The services we provide directly to clients

When ConnectHR processes data on behalf of a client (for example, an employer), the client’s own privacy policy will govern how that data is used. In such cases, we act strictly under our contractual obligations with the client and may update, amend, or delete information at their request.

What Counts as Personal Information

“Personal Information” means any information that identifies you, directly or indirectly, either on its own or in combination with other data reasonably available to us. This includes data you provide, data collected during your use of our services, and data related to our marketing or communication activities. Third-Party Services

This Privacy Policy does not extend to third-party applications, tools, or websites that may be accessed from within ConnectHR services (such as applicant tracking systems, social media sites, or partner platforms). These services are subject to their own privacy policies.

Acknowledgment of Policy

By accessing or using ConnectHR services, you confirm that you have read and understood this Privacy Policy.

GDPR and Data Controller Role

For users in the European Union under the General Data Protection Regulation

(GDPR):

  • The data controller for information processed within the ConnectHR platform is the customer organization (e.g., the employer) that provides the service to its employees or end users.
  • For information collected directly via connecthr.ae (for example, for marketing or communication), ConnectHR(HRMS IT SOLUTIONS LLC) is the data controller.

Information We Collect and How We Use It Personal Information

Through the ConnectHR platform and related services, we may collect personal data provided by our customers (employers), their administrators, and end users, as well as information generated through use of our system. This can include (but is not limited to):

  • Identification details such as name, date of birth, gender, nationality, employee ID, and government-issued identifiers (e.g., national ID or social security number).
  • Employment details such as job title, department, hire date, probation details, termination information, and employment
  • Contact details including address, email, and phone
  • Family information where relevant, such as marital status and dependent details.
  • Payroll and banking details such as salary information, overtime/bonus records, pay frequency, bank account details, and currency of
  • Compliance information such as work eligibility credentials and tax declaration details.
  • Emergency contact
  • Technical identifiers such as IP addresses or device
  • Any additional information the customer organization chooses to collect through the ConnectHR platform.

We process this information in line with contractual obligations to our customers and to deliver our HR and payroll services.

Location Information

ConnectHR does not automatically track or request location data from your mobile device. However:

  • If your employer enables location-based features (e.g., timekeeping through the ConnectHR Mobile App), location tracking may be used for attendance and compliance purposes.
  • If you apply for a role at ConnectHR via our website and select “Locate Me,” location data may be collected to display available roles near

The legal basis for such processing is either your explicit consent (in the case of job applications) or your employer’s contractual use of the service.

Attendance Logs

When employers use ConnectHR’s Time & Attendance module, we may process biometric or device logs such as employee IDs and timestamp entries (e.g., clock-ins and clock-outs). These records are used exclusively for calculating attendance and payroll, according to the rules configured by the employer.

Contact Information

If you reach out to us for more information about our services, we may collect your name, email address, and phone number. We use this data only to respond to your inquiries, provide requested information, or follow up on your interest.

Our legal basis for this is our legitimate business interest in communicating with you.

Device Information

When using our Mobile Apps, you may grant permission for access to your device’s camera and photo storage (e.g., for uploading images). Such access is optional, fully under your control, and can be revoked at any time through your device settings.

In addition, ConnectHR may use analytics tools to better understand how our apps perform. These tools may record anonymized information such as frequency of use, in-app events, performance statistics, and download source. This does not include linking analytics data to your personal profile.

Data Processed as a Service Provider

ConnectHR acts as a data processor under GDPR when handling personal data on behalf of our customers (the employers). Each customer controls its own platform environment and data settings. Our processing of personal information is strictly limited to the customer’s instructions, the functionality of our services, and applicable laws.

If you have questions about how your employer manages or processes your personal data within ConnectHR, please contact your employer or platform administrator directly.

Sharing of Your Information Third-Party Services

Our platform may contain links to third-party tools or websites. These external services are governed by their own privacy policies. ConnectHR is not responsible for their practices, and we encourage you to review their terms before using them.

Service Providers

We may share your personal information with trusted third parties who perform services on our behalf. These providers are permitted to use your data only to deliver the contracted services. Examples include:

  • Email delivery and communication services
  • Mapping and geolocation services
  • Customer service and technical support
  • Cloud infrastructure and hosting

Sub-Processors

ConnectHR also engages sub-processors—specialized vendors contracted to perform specific functions under our supervision. Sub-processors may receive limited personal data, only as necessary to support our services. Each sub- processor relationship is governed by data protection agreements, including onward transfer provisions where required.

Current Sub-Processors

Name

Purpose

Zoho

Customer support and communication (chat and email)

Pipedrive

Customer relationship management for leads and sign- ups

Google Cloud

Maps integration for attendance and location marking

Google Workspace

Calendar and meeting tools for scheduling (where enabled by customers)

Mailjet

Email communication for prospects

Calendly

Scheduling and customer coordination

 

Information Disclosed Pursuant to Business Transfers

In certain circumstances, ConnectHR may be involved in mergers, acquisitions, restructurings, or the sale of business assets. In these transactions, user information is often considered part of the transferred assets. Should ConnectHR, or substantially all of its assets, be acquired by a third party, or if we cease operations or enter bankruptcy, your personal information may be among the assets transferred. You acknowledge and agree that such transfers may occur and that any successor or acquirer may continue to use your personal information as outlined in this Privacy Policy. In the event of such a change in ownership, we will notify you by email and/or through a prominent notice on our website.

Information Disclosed for Legal or Protective Reasons

ConnectHR may disclose personal information when legally required, such as in response to valid requests by public authorities for national security or law enforcement purposes. We also reserve the right to access, preserve, and disclose personal information if we reasonably believe it is necessary to:

  1. Comply with applicable laws, regulations, legal processes, or governmental requests.
  2. Enforce this Privacy Policy and investigate potential
  3. Detect, prevent, or address fraud, security, or technical
  4. Respond to user support
  5. Protect the rights, property, or safety of ConnectHR, our users, or the

We may also share information with other organizations for fraud prevention and security purposes. Third-party service providers and sub-processors who access personal information do so only under strict confidentiality and data protection obligations. They are not permitted to use your information for their own purposes and may only process it according to our instructions.

Data Retention

Customers may request details about how ConnectHR stores and retains data (“Audit”) by contacting us. We will make reasonable efforts to respond promptly, subject to applicable law and the protection of ConnectHR’s trade secrets (a non-disclosure agreement may be required).

ConnectHR retains customer data for as long as it is needed to provide our services, fulfill contractual obligations, and comply with legal requirements. Backup files for system continuity may be retained for up to 30 days.

When a customer terminates services, an automated deletion process is initiated during the next scheduled cycle (typically quarterly or biannually). Once started, this deletion process is irreversible.

Metadata and aggregated statistical data relating to service usage may be retained beyond termination, but such data will not identify individuals and is used only for legitimate business purposes. Some information may also remain on third-party service providers’ servers in accordance with their retention policies.

Customers, as data controllers, may retain personal data of end users at their discretion. If you have questions about the data your employer retains, please contact them directly. ConnectHR is not responsible for such data retention decisions.

Contracts, billing records, and anonymized data may be retained by ConnectHR for up to five years after termination, or longer if required by law.

Security and Storage of Information

ConnectHR implements robust technical, organizational, and administrative safeguards to protect personal information against unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, or destruction. We continuously monitor and update our security practices to ensure compliance with applicable standards.

Access to personal data is restricted to ConnectHR personnel who:

  • Require access to perform their job
  • Have received appropriate and ongoing data protection
  • Are bound by confidentiality obligations under applicable

ConnectHR commits to promptly notifying customers of any security incident involving personal information, subject to legal requirements. In the event of a breach, we will work with customers to investigate, remediate, and mitigate any impact, including restoring security and preventing unauthorized use or dissemination of data.

We maintain documentation of compliance efforts, breach records, and carry

appropriate insurance coverage for data security. Please note that our website or platform may occasionally contain links to external sites. ConnectHR is not responsible for the privacy practices, policies, or content of such third-party websites.

Your Rights

Depending on your jurisdiction (for example, the UK or EU), you may have rights under applicable data protection laws, including the right to:

  • Access, correct, or delete certain personal data we hold about
  • Restrict or object to certain processing
  • Receive your data in a structured, electronic format and transmit it to another controller (“data portability”).
  • File a complaint with your local data protection

If you wish to exercise your rights, please contact us at contact@connecthr.ae. We may request additional details to verify your identity before processing your request.

Please note: where personal information has been shared with your employer or other third parties, you may need to make requests directly to them in accordance with their own privacy policies.

Changes to this Privacy Policy

This Privacy Policy may be updated from time to time. The most recent version will always be available at https://www.connecthr.ae/privacy-policy. Where material changes are made, we will notify users via a prominent notice on our website or by email (where applicable) at least seven (7) days prior to changes taking effect. All other updates take effect from the “Last Revised” date indicated on the policy.

By continuing to use our services after updates are posted, you confirm your acceptance of the revised Privacy Policy.

For questions or comments regarding this Privacy Policy, please email us at contact@connecthr.ae. We aim to respond within a reasonable timeframe, and no later than 30 business days.

  • High – Significant functionality degraded with major business

  • Low – Minor issues, cosmetic bugs, or informational

  • If SLA timelines are at risk, incidents are escalated functionally or hierarchically to ensure complianceConnectHR – Security Document-….

    • Corrective and preventive action plans to prevent recurrenceConnectHR – Security Document -… ConnectHR – Security Document -…

  • Contingency plans include:

  • Assign a Customer Administrator to coordinate with ConnectHR

7. Data Retention & Deletion

  • Backups retained for 30 days for
  • On service termination, customer data is permanently deleted in the next automated cycle (quarterly to biannual).

8. Support & Escalation

    1. First-line Support
    2. Technical Specialist / Developer
    3. Incident Manager
    4. Senior Management (if unresolved within SLA).

9. Review & Updates

This SLA will be reviewed periodically to align with evolving business, legal, and security requirements. Updates will be communicated to customers with reasonable notice. Continued use of ConnectHR Services constitutes acceptance of the updated SLA.

  • Illegal Activities – Hosting, distributing, or promoting illegal content, including activities in violation of UAE Cybercrime Law or other applicable laws.

  • Malicious Code – Distributing or hosting malware, viruses, trojan horses, worms, ransomware, spyware, or similar harmful
  • Offensive or Defamatory Content – Publishing material that is obscene, defamatory, abusive, harassing, or invasive of personal

2. Email and Messaging Abuse

You must not use ConnectHR Cloud Services to send unsolicited, harmful, or deceptive messages. Prohibited practices include:

  • Spam – Sending or enabling the distribution of unsolicited bulk messages or commercial communications without verified recipient
  • Spoofing or Misrepresentation – Using forged headers, false identities, or misleading information in
  • Third-Party Abuse – Using third-party messaging systems in connection with spam or other abusive practices facilitated through ConnectHR Services.

Any bulk or automated messaging must comply with applicable laws (including consent requirements) and ConnectHR may require proof of such compliance.

3. Security Violations

You may not attempt to compromise the integrity, security, or availability of ConnectHR Cloud Services or systems. Prohibited actions include:

  • Security Research without Authorization – Conducting penetration testing, vulnerability scanning, or security audits without ConnectHR’s prior written

  • Social Engineering or Other Attacks – Engaging in phishing, pretexting, or other manipulative methods targeting ConnectHR, its users, or partners.

  • Third-Party Attacks – Using ConnectHR Cloud to launch attacks, probes, or disruptions against third-party networks or

Violations may also result in civil or criminal liability.

ConnectHR may update this AUP from time to time to reflect changes in laws, regulations, or service requirements. The most current version will be made available on www.connecthr.ae. Continued use of the Services constitutes acceptance of the updated AUP.

title: FAQ Payroll Management
content:
Payroll Management
Is there a payroll tax in the UAE?

No, there is no payroll tax in the UAE, which means employees don’t have to pay income taxes.

Can Connect HR payroll software be customised for different types of businesses?

Yes, Connect HR payroll software solution can be customised for businesses of all sizes and industries, making it easier to adapt to your specific payroll needs.

How does Connect HR ensure payroll compliance for businesses in the UAE?

Whether you are operating in a free zone or on the mainland, Connect HR will automatically and accurately calculate and process payroll in compliance with the UAE’s local labour laws. The system automatically receives updates to ensure your business always stays compliant. Multiple payment modes supported. A Bank SIF or exchange file can be generated. And easily distribute pay slips to the employees.

Can the Connect HR payroll system handle multiple salary components?

Yes, the software can handle multiple salary components, including basic pay, bonuses, deductions, reimbursements, leave encashments, etc.

Is Connect HR’s attendance management software for every team or company?

Yes, Connect HR’s attendance management system is designed for every organisation that wants to:

  • Capture attendance in real time
  • Make their remote workforce agile with geo-fencing and IP
  • Create custom attendance policies
  • Accurately track work hours, absences, and overtime details for fair payroll
  • Get detailed attendance reports
Does Connect HR have a mobile app for attendance management?

Absolutely! Connect HR’s mobile app (Android and iOS) that allows:

  • Remote and field workers to check in and out from anywhere.
  • Employees are to mark attendance only from designated locations.
  • Employees are to raise requests for missed or incorrect attendance entries.
  • Managers will approve or reject requests in seconds.
  • Supports Geo Fencing and Geo Tagging
  • Bulk Check-In / Check Out option for Supervisors to mark attendance for their team members.
  • Employees can view their Assigned Shift information
How does the software handle overtime calculations?

Connect HR automatically calculates overtime based on predefined rules, ensuring fair and accurate payroll processing.

What is an attendance management software solution?

An attendance management software solution automates the process of tracking, managing, and processing employee attendance. Its main features include time tracking, scheduling, reporting, rostering, and more capabilities that help improve accuracy and ensure compliance with labour regulations.

What is a loan management system (LMS)?

A loan management system is a software that automates the entire loan lifecycle, from loan application and approval to repayment and deductions.

Can employees request for a Loan via application?

Yes. Employees can request for the loan and can also track the EMI’s.

How can Connect HR's full and final software streamline the separation process?

It integrates with payroll details such as unpaid salary, bonus, unused leaves, gratuity, etc., helping avoid errors during the separation process.

When is the full and final settlement done?

The employer has to pay all entitlements and settle all debts within 14 days after the employee’s final day of employment.

Who is eligible for end of service gratuity as per the UAE labour law?

Gratuity is a monetary payment, which is paid in a lump sum at the end of the employee’s tenure, if the service period exceeds one year.

Is Connect HR’s reimbursement tool safe to use?

Yes. Connect HR employs advanced security measures to keep your data safe and secure, preventing unauthorised access to records.

Can I upload expense receipts with my mobile?

Yes, Receipts can be uploaded by mobile APP ( IOS and Android ) and also from the browser

How to ensure teams follow your expense policies?

Connect HR lets you incorporate your company’s customised expense policy within the platform so that every employee can clearly see which costs are allowed or not. This helps prevent claims against the policy.

Why is expense management important?

Expense management helps companies control costs, have better control over employee spending, ensure compliance, and streamline the reimbursement process. This further helps prevent fraud and helps people make informed financial decisions.

What is leave encashment meaning?

Leave encashment is the amount received by an employee for unused paid leave provided by the current employer.

How is the leave encashment amount calculated?

With Connect HR, you can automatically calculate the leave encashment amount for eligible employees. It cuts down time-consuming and repetitive manual calculations, saving you time.

What types of leaves are eligible for encashment?

Employees in the UAE are entitled to 30 paid leaves, and any number of unused paid annual leaves is entitled to a payout.

Can sick leave, maternity leave, or paternity leave be encashed?

No. Only annual paid leaves can be encashed.

title: FAQ HR Management
content:
HR Management
What is Connect HR’s HR Management System?
It’s a cloud-based platform designed for UAE businesses to manage HR processes like Recruitment , payroll, attendance, leaves, employee benefits, Performance , onboarding, offboarding, and employee records—all in one place.
Can I use your HR management tool for multiple office locations?
Yes, you can manage HR tasks across different office branches, with role-based access and centralized reporting.
Does it comply with UAE labour laws?
Absolutely. Our HR management software is designed in alignment with MOHRE regulations, WPS guidelines, and the UAE’s data protection guidelines.
Is my company’s data protected?
Yes, all data is encrypted and hosted securely to comply with the UAE’s PDPL.
What is Connect HR PMS?

Connect HR is a complete performance management solution designed to be more effective, efficient, and time-saving in performance management. It automates the entire process, from managing and reviewing employee performance to providing feedback and handling appraisals across roles, levels, and teams.

What are the unique features of Connect HR PMS?
Connect HR PMS offer several unique features, such as preset goal templates, real-time feedback tracking, 360-degree performance reviews, data-driven reports, and more.
Can I customise the performance review process?
Yes, Connect HR allows you to customise the performance review process according to your organisation’s goals and preferences, ensuring fair and continuous evaluations.
What are performance management best practices?

Some of the topmost performance management best practices include the following:

  • Provide frequent and timely reviews
  • Keep all concerned particles, including employees, involved
  • Unbiased and transparent approach
  • Automate performance management process to save time and ensure accuracy
What does an asset management system do?
An asset management company tracks, monitors, and manages a company’s tangible and non-tangible assets to improve productivity, remain compliant, avoid equipment failure, and protect employees.
Does Connect HR's asset management tool offer a free trial?
Yes, take the 7-day free trial of our asset management tool to explore its features.
Is Connect HR asset management software customisable for businesses?
Yes, you can customise our asset management module for business sizes, from startups to large enterprises, to fit your unique needs.
What is the employee accommodation policy in the UAE 2025?

The UAE sets strict rules and regulations to ensure that labor accommodations meet international safety, security, hygiene, and comfort standards. Here are the main regulations:

  • A minimum space of 3 square meters for every worker
  • No more than eight people per room for sleeping
  • At least one washroom with toilet, washbasin and shower for every five people
  • Clean and well-maintained dining space facility
  • Properly ventilated and well-lit
  • Robust emergency exit plan, fire safety equipment and evacuation system

Non-compliance with employee accommodation policy can result in hefty fines or even the suspension of a business license.

How does staff accommodation affect employee retention?
When provided with adequate, clean and well-maintained accommodation, both labor and staff feel valued by the company. This increases job satisfaction and employee engagement.
Could employees or labor check accommodation details?
YES they can check the Aminities.
Is there any feature that can handle accommodation-related complaints from occupants?
  • A complaint box can be placed in a designated area within the camp.
  • Workers can submit their concerns anonymously at any time.
  • The box can be opened once a month by the camp manager to review and address the issues raised.

This initiative could help improve communication, address grievances effectively, and create a more positive and transparent environment for the workers.

Why is a document management system important for HR?
HR professionals have to deal with mountains of documents involved in onboarding/offboarding, obtaining e-signs, sending notices, processing terminations, and you name it. Managing these documents manually can be time-consuming and mundane. So, automating document management makes sense. Connect HR document management module simplified document management for HR while ensuring security and compliance. It also ensures all HR-related documents within your organisation are stored safely and can be accessed (controlled access) anytime, anywhere.
How can businesses benefit from a document management system?
A reliable document management system has many benefits, including fast and secure access, quick collaboration, easy distribution, cost and time savings, sustainability, and many more.
How does the e-signature function work in the Connect HR document management module?
E-signature means getting documents signed online. Connect HR’s DMS integrates with leading e-sign platforms, such as Docusign and Adobe Sign, to streamline the e-signing process for your organisation. So, you can use our DMS to send different documents to individuals or a team for e-signing and managing them efficiently.
Can I check the document history?
Yes, you can check all previous versions of any document and all activities performed on these files through Connect HR’s DMS.
What is onboarding and offboarding software?
Onboarding and offboarding software automates the processes of hiring or existing new employees, such as document management, communication, and compliance.
Does Connect HR onboarding and offboarding software support remote teams?
Absolutely! Connect HR is a cloud-based solution that supports onboarding and offboarding remote teams.
Is Connect HR onboarding software secure?
It’s 100% secure. We have developed this software in adherence with the industry’s highest data security protocols and regulations in the UAE.
Does it support a customisable onboarding program?
Yes, Connect HR lets you customize workflows, forms, and content to align with your company’s unique needs and to provide tailored experiences to new hires.

title: FAQ Dashboard
content:
Dashboard
Can I choose widgets for my dashboard view?
Yes. Connect HR’s dynamic dashboards are highly customizable. So, you add, remove, and rearrange widgets as per your preferences.
Can every department have its own dashboard?
Yes. You can create a role-based dashboard for each of your Finance, HR, and Admin teams so they can see only what’s relevant to them.
Can I access the dashboard on smartphones?
Yes, you can access Connect HR Dynamic Dashboard on desktops, smartphones, and tablets.
Does Dynamic Dashboard integrate with other Connect HR features?
Yes, the Dynamic Dashboard pulls data from payroll, document management, and employee profiles—all in a single location.
Is this payroll dashboard compliant with UAE WPS regulations?
Yes. Our dynamic dashboard for employee payroll is fully compliant with the UAE’s WPS system. It automatically generates WPS SIF (Salary Information File) files ready for submission.
Does the payroll dashboard support multi-company payroll?
Yes. Using our payroll dashboard, you can manage payroll for multiple companies or branches from a single dashboard, thanks to user-based access controls and consolidated/segregated reporting features.
Can employees access their payroll details using the dashboard?
Yes. Employees can access the dashboard for payslips, salary breakdowns, and download confirmation for WPS payment.
Does this document expiry dashboard track the documents of Free Zone companies?
Yes, with the Connect HR document expiration management dashboard, you can stay on top of every document, whether you operate under Free Zone authorities or the Mainland or need to ensure compliance with MOHRE, WPS, or any other regulatory body.
Can I track multiple documents for every employee?
Yes, you can! This dynamic dashboard for document expiry lets you track multiple documents per employee, like visa, passport, driving license, Emirates ID, and more—all from a single place.
Will I get automatic reminders on my mobile or email?
You can configure the dashboard to receive reminders for document expiry on SMS, email, Mobile APP push notifications or WhatsApp.
How does the Document Expiration Dashboard help with compliance in the UAE?
You get automatic expiry reminders so that you can renew all documents in a timely manner, which helps maintain compliance. In addition, audit-ready reports ensure you stay updated and fulfill regulatory requirements, thus minimising or eliminating the risks of non-compliance.
Can I customise how far in advance I receive alerts?
Yes. You can choose to receive notifications a few days or weeks before the actual milestone.
Can I automate messages or announcements?
Yes. You can pre-schedule emails, messages, or dashboard banners to go out on the day of the event.
Does this integrate with our reward systems?
Yes. Connect HR can be connected to your existing employee reward or gift card for more impactful celebrations.
What if an employee’s birthday isn’t added?
In this case, you can manually add any missing information to the platform at any time.
Can I set who can see milestones?
Yes. You can set role-based access so each user can see what’s relevant to their team.

title: FAQ Security
content:
Security
How is sensitive client data protected?
Client data is segregated into independent databases and folders, encrypted both at rest and in transit, and protected with strong access controls and monitoring.
How are backups managed?
Data backups run daily, are logged, stored in multiple locations, and tested monthly for integrity to ensure availability and reliability.
How is business continuity ensured?
A Business Impact Analysis (BIA) defines recovery priorities, downtime tolerances, and contingency strategies, ensuring critical functions like payroll and onboarding are restored promptly.
How are encryption keys managed?
Encryption keys are securely generated, stored, rotated, and separated from encrypted data using centralized management systems and hardware security modules.
How is secure browsing ensured?
Risky and executable file downloads are blocked within Google Workspace, supported by continuous monitoring and user awareness training.
How is email protected?
Emails are secured against malware and spam with Google Workspace’s built-in anti-malware, spam filters, and advanced threat protection. Staff are trained to spot phishing attempts.
How are security events monitored?
Business applications are continuously monitored with SIEM tools, log analysis, and alerting systems to quickly detect and respond to threats.
How is the network secured?
The network is segregated into zones, secured with strong encryption (AES, TLS, VPN), protected by firewalls and intrusion prevention systems, and regularly audited.
How are wireless networks protected?
Wireless access uses WPA3 encryption, strong authentication, hidden SSIDs, strategic access point placement, and regular security audits.
How is remote access controlled?
Only approved devices can connect, protected with VPNs, MFA, biometric authentication, and continuous monitoring.
How are mobile devices managed?
All devices must be enrolled in Mobile Device Management (MDM), use only approved applications, and can be remotely wiped if lost or stolen.
How are business applications classified?
Applications are inventoried, risk-assessed, and assigned maximum acceptable downtime limits, with continuous monitoring and incident response plans in place.
How are employees trained on security?
Employees receive mandatory role-based training, social engineering awareness campaigns, behavioral awareness programs, and continuous updates on emerging threats.
How is physical access to facilities controlled?
Physical access rights are periodically reviewed, promptly revoked when no longer needed, and fully documented for compliance and audits.
How is security integrated into projects?
All projects undergo security testing, vulnerability scans, code reviews, and penetration testing before going live.

title: FAQ Privacy & Policy
content:
Privacy & Policy
What personal data does ConnectHR collect and how is it segregated?
ConnectHR stores each client’s data in an independent database, ensuring it is not mixed with other clients’ data. Additional files like documents or images are stored in separate folders with strict access restrictions. This approach guarantees clear segregation of customer data.
How is employee and client data protected in transit and at rest?
Sensitive data is encrypted both at rest and in transit. Data transmitted between client and server is secured using TLS (SSL/TLS with SHA256 certificates). At rest, data is encrypted within databases, with strong encryption algorithms such as AES-256 applied to maintain confidentiality
How is access to data controlled?
Access to systems and databases is strictly regulated using role-based access control (RBAC). Only authorized personnel are allowed access to the partitions and databases they need for their roles. Multi-factor authentication (MFA) and strong authentication policies are also in place for network administration and remote access.
How is data backed up and how long is it retained?
Data backups are performed daily, with application data archived in a secure format (ZIP/SQL) and stored in multiple locations. Monthly integrity tests are conducted by restoring backups to ensure the reliability of the system. Backup logs are maintained, reviewed, and retained in accordance with organizational and regulatory requirements.
How does ConnectHR ensure compliance and employee awareness?
The organization complies with international standards such as GDPR and enforces policies for cryptographic controls, data segregation, and access management. Employees undergo regular security awareness training, including role-based education, phishing simulations, and social engineering awareness campaigns, to reduce risks from human error.

title: FAQ General
content:
General FAQs
What is an HRMS?

HRMS stands for Human Resource Management System. It’s a software application that helps companies effectively manage their human resources and payroll processes while ensuring compliance with mandated local laws. It combines and automates HR functions into a single, centralised platform, thus simplifying and streamlining your daily HR operations for improved efficiency.

What is Connect HR?

Connect HR is a highly customisable, cloud-based HR and payroll management system specifically built for UAE businesses. It provides a comprehensive set of services—onboarding/offboarding, performance management, time and attendance, payroll management, employee engagement, and document generation—to help UAE businesses efficiently manage their HR processes while saving time and cutting costs.

How do I get started with Connect HR?

Connect HR offers three plans—Basic, Professional, and Enterprise. You can also contact our sales team for a custom plan tailored to your business needs. Get started by signing up for a pricing plan or filling out our form.

Is Connect HR compliant with UAE labour laws and WPS regulations?

Yes. Connect HR is fully compliant with UAE labour laws. It‘s designed to generate WPS-compliant payroll files automatically. Additionally, we keep the system updated with changes in MOHRE, Free Zone, and GCC-specific regulations, ensuring your business remains legally compliant in the UAE.

Can I use Connect HR for a large business with 1,000+ employees?

Yes. Connect HR is built for businesses of any size—from SMEs to large enterprises. This scalable HR and payroll management system can easily cater to your shrinking or growing business needs and size.

Do I need technical experience to use Connect HR?

No! Connect HR is a user-friendly HRMS designed for busy managers. It features a clean and intuitive dashboard that requires no technical background to navigate. We also provide full onboarding and live support to our clients.

Can my employees use Connect HR too?

Yes. Connect HR includes a multilingual employee self-service portal. Staff can view payslips, request leave, update documents, and more, right from their mobile phones or desktops.

How secure is my data on Connect HR?

We use enterprise-grade encryption, role-based access, and UAE-compliant cloud servers. Your employee and business data are safe, confidential, and always accessible when you need them.

Can I customise the dashboard for different team members?

Yes. You can create role-based views—so HR, Finance, Operations, and Executives see only the information relevant to them. You control who can access, edit, or approve actions.

What if an employee’s insurance policy is about to expire?

In this situation, you’ll receive an automatic reminder by email , Mobile App Push notification and on the dashboard. You can also set custom notification periods, choosing the number of days in advance.

Can I upload records related to an existing insurance policy to the platform?

What is an HRMS?

HRMS stands for Human Resource Management System. It’s a software application that helps companies effectively manage their human resources and payroll processes while ensuring compliance with mandated local laws. It combines and automates HR functions into a single, centralised platform, thus simplifying and streamlining your daily HR operations for improved efficiency.

What is Connect HR?

Connect HR is a cloud-based HR and payroll management system specifically built for UAE businesses. It provides a comprehensive set of services—onboarding/offboarding, performance management, time and attendance, payroll management, employee engagement, and document generation—to help UAE businesses efficiently manage their HR processes while saving time and cutting costs.

We use enterprise-grade encryption, role-based access, and UAE-compliant cloud servers. Your employee and business data are safe, confidential, and always accessible when you need them.

Yes. You can create role-based views—so HR, Finance, Operations, and Executives see only the information relevant to them. You control who can access, edit, or approve actions.

title: Shipping Logistics
content:
Simplifying HR Operations for UAE Shipping & Logistics Firms with Connect HR

In the UAE’s fast-paced logistics and shipping sector, where time is money, companies can’t afford HR delays, compliance lapses, or payroll errors. With a workforce that includes drivers, warehouse staff, customs clerks, and cross-border operatives, HR teams face unique complexities in managing shift rotations, visa renewals, multi-entity payroll, and WPS compliance. 

Connect HR helps UAE-based shipping and logistics firms streamline workforce management, ensure regulatory compliance, and improve visibility across diverse teams and remote work sites. Here’s how Connect HR transforms people operations in logistics, end-to-end.

Challenges

Scattered Workforce and Decentralised Operations

Lack of visibility when tracking staff location, hours, and document status across disconnected environments.

WPS Payroll Challenges for Drivers & Shift Workers

Manually preparing WPS files and handling multiple payment structures creates a high risk of errors and delays.

Cross-Border Visa & Document Complexity

Cross-Border Visa & Document Complexity

High Turnover & Onboarding Bottlenecks

High staff turnover means HRs are overengaged in processing repetitive paperwork instead of focusing on retention or training.

Solutions

Live Workforce Dashboard for Multi-Site Visibility

A dynamic dashboard offers real-time visibility of where employees are deployed—across warehouses, border posts, customs, or delivery hubs.

Automated Visa & Document Lifecycle Tracking

The platform tracks visa issuance, labour card renewals, Emirates ID expiry, and other compliance-critical documents for every staff member.

WPS-Compliant, Role-Based Payroll Engine

Automatically generates WPS files and breakdowns for each pay cycle, ensuring on-time, error-free salary disbursal with full compliance.

One-Click Digital Onboarding & Contract Generation

HRs can generate bilingual offer letters, employment contracts, and onboarding documents, and employees can upload and review documents digitally.

Multilingual Mobile Self-Service Portal

Workers can check their payslips, contract details, leave balances, and document status in their preferred language (English or Arabic).

Results

Here’s how logistics companies using Connect HR have streamlined their operations, improved compliance, and scaled faster with less HR overhead:

80% Reduction in Visa-Related Penalties

With automated alerts and trackers, companies avoided late renewals and fines. Every visa and labour card stayed within compliance timelines.

50% Faster Onboarding Time for Fleet & Warehouse Staff

Digital contract generation and centralised document uploads cut onboarding delays in half—getting drivers and handlers on the road, faster.

100% Accuracy in WPS Payroll Submissions

Automated pay calculations and file generation eliminated manual errors. Salaries were always disbursed on time, improving retention and compliance.

4x Increase in Worker Self-Service Engagement

Drivers and loaders actively used the mobile portal to view shifts, access documents, and raise HR requests, cutting walk-ins and follow-ups.

Ready to Move Smarter?

Whether you’re scaling your fleet or managing multiple logistics hubs across the Emirates, Connect HR gives you the tools to stay compliant, reduce delays, and empower your people.

Book your free demo today and see how Connect HR delivers control, clarity, and compliance for your logistics workforce.
Book a demo
Talk to an expert

Have full control over your employee insurance cycle

All without juggling with spreadsheets or other hassles.
What makes us different

Connect HR insurance management module

Centralized insurance profiles
Every employee’s insurance details, like policy ID, premium cost, and dependents covered stored securely in one place.
Auto-reminders for renewals
Set and forget. Connect HR tracks insurance policies for expiry dates and sends timely alerts to HR teams.

Insurance cards, policy agreements, and claim forms are digitally stored and accessible. No more emailing PDFs to and fro.

Know your exact spending on employee insurance. Negotiate better premiums and plan your budgets smarter.

Easily assign or remove insurance plans during employee onboarding and offboarding with compliance and transparency.

Manage employee insurance with compliance and care

Book your live demo

Frequently asked questions.

What if an employee’s insurance policy is about to expire?

In this situation, you’ll receive an automatic reminder by email, Mobile App Push notification and on the dashboard. You can also set custom notification periods, choosing the number of days in advance.

Can I upload records related to an existing insurance policy to the platform?

Yes. Our team can help you easily upload and store all existing insurance documents into Connect HR.

Is the data safe?

Yes. The module is backed by enterprise-grade encryption and UAE-compliant cloud infrastructure. So, all insurance records and personal data are protected.

Can employees access their insurance details using the software?

Yes. Employees can use a self-service portal to view their policy-related details like insurance cards, coverage, and expiry dates.

You have different questions? 

Our team will answer all your questions. We ensure a quick response.

title: F&B (Food & Beverage)
content:
Streamlining HR & Compliance in the UAE F&B Sector with Connect HR

The UAE’s food and beverage industry is fast-paced and highly regulated, encompassing restaurants, cafes, quick-service chains, cloud kitchens, catering companies, hotel-based outlets, and international franchise brands. Businesses operating within the hospitality sector often require centralized HR software for hotels in UAE to manage payroll, shifts, compliance, and workforce operations efficiently. These businesses operate long hours (often late nights and split shifts) and employ predominantly expatriate staff on time-limited work visas. High employee turnover is common, meaning HR teams are continually onboarding new hires and offboarding leavers.

Despite the sector’s complexity, many F&B operators still rely on manual processes or basic spreadsheets for HR, and this sets the stage for critical challenges.

Key Challenges

Operating an F&B business in the UAE presents several operational and compliance pain points unique to the local context. The most common ones are:

High Turnover Rate

Because HRs are constantly onboarding and offboarding, the heavy administrative load can lead to delays or errors, bringing penalties for noncompliance.

Irregular Working Hours

Manually managing complex shift schedules and overtime compliance is at risk of breaching UAE labour law limits on working hours or providing breaks.

End-of-Service & Payroll Compliance Risks

The UAE’s labour law has strict WPS mandates on payroll and end-of-service gratuity. Any delays or miscalculations can result in legal disputes or fines.

Solutions

Connect HR is a UAE-tailored HR management platform that provides a strategic approach that automates workflows, ensures compliance, and gives F&B managers the tools to stay on top of their workforce. Hospitality businesses such as restaurants, cafés, and hotels require centralized workforce management to handle payroll, attendance, shifts, and compliance efficiently. Explore our HR Software for Hotels in UAE solution.

Automated Onboarding & Visa Management

Automates the entire employee lifecycle from hiring to exit, cutting down the manual effort in HR processes.

Smart Scheduling & Payroll Alignment

Create rosters accounting for split shifts, weekends, and peak hours. This data flows into payroll calculations, eliminating manual errors.

Multilingual Documentation & Self-Service

Provides multilingual support (English and Arabic ) for both HR and employees, establishing clear communication.

Real-Time Compliance Dashboard & Analytics

A dynamic dashboard gives instant insight into compliance and HR KPIs and sends proactive notifications for important events.

Results

By implementing Connect HR, F&B businesses in the UAE have seen significant operational improvements and risk reduction. Similar operational efficiencies can also be achieved by hospitality groups and hotel chains using our HR software for hotels in Dubai and UAE.

100% Compliance

100% on-time payment of wages and end-of-service gratuities, eliminating fines for late disbursement.

Companies report faster payroll processing, onboarding, and offboarding so that they can focus on improving customer service.
